_comment: Copy to tracker.config.json (gitignored) and edit. Every key is optional; the values below are the defaults. TRACKER_DATA_DIR and TRACKER_TZ override this file.

_docs.dataDir: Where day files and projects.json live. Kept outside the repo so tracked time is not committed to the tool's own history. '~' is expanded.
_docs.tz: IANA timezone for local-day boundaries and --at parsing. null means use the system timezone.
_docs.autoCommit: If true and dataDir is a git repo, commit after every mutation. Failures are non-fatal warnings.
_docs.defaultProject: Project id used when a task is started without one and nothing else is open.
_docs.roundStep: Default minute granularity for reports (e.g. 15). null means no rounding.
_docs.attributionStrategy: How overlapping time is split: 'equal', 'weighted', or 'exclusive'. See docs/SCHEMA.md.
_docs.lookbackDays: How many days back to search for still-open entries.
